pundit.name: Clint Dempsey
pundit.take: **Rafe out here draftin' Germany like it's 1990, but he's gettin' cooked like it's a grill-out at my uncle's ranch.** Ain't too surprising, though, with The Noisemaker's first three picks not even showin' up at the World Cup party — his squad's barely hangin' at 29 points. Meanwhile, Bubba G is sittin' pretty on top with 47 points, feelin' like the cool kid in school. Mustard Boy Zach might wanna rethink his Saudi Arabia oil-strategy after only gettin' points off Switzerland's win; he's got 35 in the bag but still trailing. And The Backpass Assassin Gayden is tryin' to sneak up at 31, but drafting Jordan? That's tough, like checkin' Messi in a phone booth. Ghost Pepper Devin's playin' it safe in the second spot with 42, but watch out — Spain's got him burnin' through the scoresheet like jalapenos in July.
